reactions.brokenPromise: You said you had me, Cuzzo. I waited on that. The chain’s gone now. We can still talk, but I’m not forgetting it.
reactions.fulfilledPromise: You came through for me. I got my chain back, and I know what you did to make that happen. That means something.
reactions.supersededPromise: Pablo handled it. My chain’s back. You didn’t get the chance to finish what you promised — we’re square on that.
reactions.playerResolved: My chain’s back. You helped me get it home. I appreciate that, Cuzzo.
reactions.leadershipResolved: My chain’s back. Leadership sorted it out. I’m glad it’s over.
reactions.abandoned: They sold it. There’s no buying it back from them now. I’ve got to move on.

followUp.leadershipAware: You said you’d help. Pablo’s heard about it now, so I’m waiting to see what he does. Nothing’s settled yet.
followUp.pendingPromise: I’m counting on you. They still have my chain. Talk them down, cover the demand, or see if Pablo will handle his people. Just don’t let this sit.

responses.declined: Alright. I wanted your help, but I heard you. I’ll figure out what I can do.

opening.leadershipAware: Pablo’s heard about it, but nothing’s settled.
opening.dialogue: Cuzzo, three young Angels took my diamond chain while I was out with my girl. I’m alright. They want ${amount} to give it back. {details}Can you help me get it home?

choices.acknowledge: I hear you. Return to the city.
choices.promise: I’ll help you get it back. I give you my word.
choices.clarify: Tell me what happened. Who was involved?
choices.decline: I can’t get involved in this.
choices.delay: Let me think. I’m not promising yet.
choices.acknowledgeReaction: I hear you. Return to the city.

clarification.dialogue: Dizzy, Baby Canon, Joker. Three of them, trying to get a name. They want ${amount}. Loco’s locked up; Pablo runs things out here. This wasn’t authorized. I wasn’t badly hurt. I want my property back, not more trouble.
